Options:
  --tag NAME                        Tag the resulting image
  -t NAME                           Tag the resulting image
  --file FILE                       Select a Containerfile
  -f FILE                           Select a Containerfile
  --build-arg KEY_VALUE             Set a build argument
  --no-cache                        Disable build cache
  --pull [POLICY]                     Select the image pull policy
  --target STAGE                    Select the final build stage
  --platform PLATFORM               Select the target platform
  --quiet                           Reduce build output
